sentences.en: Thinking is difficult, and therefore many people only pass judgment.
sentences.zh: 思考是困难的，因此许多人只是随口评判。

sentences.en: Those are all false judgments, you take it all wrong.
sentences.zh: 这些都是错误的判断，你完全搞错了。

sentences.en: You have heard, seen, suffered, you have him; give judgment.
sentences.zh: 你听到了，看到了，经历了，给他下结论吧。

senses.zh: 判断，判断力；意见，看法；判决，裁决；审判；判断力；识别力；鉴赏力；见解
